events.comment: Necromancer_Boss: the Necromancer fight. The scene (Boss_Necromancer) links Player_Movement and Combat_Shared before this sheet, so every Just... flag Combat_Shared sets is ready here. He is a caster who keeps his distance: a fixed rotation of spells per phase (RotP1, RotP2; one letter per spell, see the Start a spell group), and reactions: a nova when the player crowds him, a blink to the far side after BlinkHits quick hits, a flinch when a lunge lands. Posture: plain sword hits only add SwordPosture (MeleeDamagesPosture is off, as for the Gunslinger). The real way to break him is to deflect: a deflected bolt flies back at him and adds BoltPosture when it lands, and deflecting the nova or a soul pillar adds posture through Combat_Shared. Two lives. Losing the first starts the Rekindle: he vanishes, reappears in the middle, roars, and the arena turns from green to red (BgMix) for phase 2: faster casts, more bolts, and the skull swarm. Every number is a variable on the Necromancer object, so tune him there.

Scene start: music, timers (the template's Debug_UI text is hidden), and the intro: he fades in out of nothing (Float), then raises his staff (Cast) and the fight starts. His bars stay hidden until then. He is invulnerable during the intro.

parameters: assets/Music/Faded Keys_Broken Piano_Horror Music_Royalty Free Music_Vivek Abhishek.mp3

events.comment: His state clock: StateT counts the seconds since the current state or step started. HitFlash counts down the red flash after a hit.
Hits taken in a row: forgotten after 2.5 s without a hit (HitWindow).

events.name: Necromancer: holds (no life is taken without a deathblow)

events.comment: Death hold: his HP reached 0 on his last life without a posture break (Combat_Shared just set JustDied). Instead of dying at once, he is posture-broken at 0.01 HP for StunDuration seconds with the deathblow orb up, so the fight ends on a deathblow. A deathblow from a real posture break (Player.IsDeathblow) is left alone. DeathHold: 0 not yet, 1 held, 2 the hold ran out. The same as the Leaf Ranger's.
Death hold: no deathblow came before the stun ran out, so he finishes dying on his own. HP 0 lets Combat_Shared take the last life next frame; clearing JustRecovered keeps him down.

Life hold: his HP reached 0 with a life to spare. Combat_Shared already took the life (JustLostLife), which would start phase 2 with no chance of a deathblow. He gets the life back and is posture-broken at 0.01 HP instead, like the death hold. Not during a deathblow: that one takes its life this same way, and it must stand.

Life hold: no deathblow before the stun ran out, so he loses the life anyway: HP 0 lets Combat_Shared take it next frame, and the Rekindle starts. LifeHold 2 keeps the hold above from catching it again.
Life hold: the life is gone (to the deathblow or the timeout), so the hold is over.
The player is gone (died): stop casting and stand idle.
Final death: everything he cast is cleared, the bars go, and he crumbles to dust (Death). Combat_Shared's victory script waits for the animation, then fades back to the hub.
Safety net: no lives left, but he is not in his death state, so die now.
Lost a life: the Rekindle. Everything he cast is cleared, he cannot be hit, and phase 2 starts once it is over (see the Rekindle group).

Posture broken (not while dead, rekindling or in the intro): whatever he was casting is cancelled and he staggers, then holds the last frame of Hurt (see Stunned). He can always be hit now. Combat_Shared runs the stun and the deathblow.
Stun over: carry on. A deathblow that took a life is handled by the Rekindle above.
A lunge landed: he flinches (Hurt) and loses his spell, but only while he is idle, drifting, or winding up a bolt or a fan. His big spells, the blink and the Rekindle ignore it.
Hit by the sword: SwordPosture posture (the shared rules add none for him), a short red flash, and one more for the blink count. Combat_Shared never clears JustHitByPlayer, so this does.

Holds: plain hits cannot land while he is held at 0.01 HP, so only the deathblow (which ignores Invulnerable) or the timeout ends the life. The posture-broken event above clears Invulnerable, so this runs after it.
Intro, step 0: fade in over IntroFade seconds.
Intro, step 1: the staff goes up; when the cast is over the bars appear and the fight starts.
Rekindle, step 0: he reels (Hurt) for 0.6 s.
Rekindle, step 1: he fades out where he stands.
Rekindle, step 2: he fades back in, in the middle of the arena.
Rekindle, step 3: the roar. The arena bleeds from green to red over RekindleTint seconds (BgMix, read by the arena tint script), and the screen shakes when the staff flares.
Rekindle over: phase 2. Faster animations (so faster casts), and the phase 2 rotation from its start.
Stunned: hold the last frame of Hurt until Combat_Shared ends the stun.
Flinch over after FlinchTime seconds.

events.name: Necromancer: neutral (facing, distance, choosing a spell)

events.comment: Neutral: face the player.
Crowding: CrowdT counts how long the player has stood within NovaRange of him.
Distance: he drifts toward a player who stays further than KeepFar, and away from one closer than KeepNear (unless the wall is behind him). Float while moving, Idle while still.
Keep him inside the arena.
Crowded for CrowdTime seconds: the nova, if it is off cooldown.
Hit BlinkHits times in a row (or crowded twice as long with the nova on cooldown): he blinks to the far side and answers with a bolt.

The rotation: every ActionDelayP1 (phase 2: ActionDelayP2) seconds the next letter of RotP1 (RotP2). B bolt, F fan, R rain, E eruption, S skull swarm. N (nova) and K (blink) are reactions, but work in a rotation too.

Debug keys (Combat_Shared's DEBUG_KEYS switch turns them off): Numpad1 bolt, Numpad2 fan, Numpad3 rain, Numpad4 eruption, Numpad5 nova, Numpad6 blink, Numpad7 skull swarm (any phase), Numpad9 drops him to 0 HP (the hold, then a deathblow or the timeout). F3 draws the hitboxes.
Debug: F3 toggles drawing every bounding box (blue) and hitbox (red), including his invisible attack boxes.
Each letter starts its spell. Code is cleared, so the rotation picks again after the spell ends and ActionTimer has run.
A letter he does not know (a typo in a rotation): drop it.

Bolt (Summon): the skull in his hand flares and spits a bolt at the player on frame 12 (index 11). Phase 2: a second one on frame 15. Bolts can be deflected one per press (they are ranged); a deflected bolt flies back at him.

Fan (Barrage): on frame 7 (index 6) the staff throws FanCountP1 (phase 2: FanCountP2) bolts in a spread FanSpread degrees apart, centred on the player. One deflect stops the whole fan (SharedDeflect 1), and every deflected bolt flies back.

parameters: atan2(Player.CenterY() - Necro_Bolt.Y(), Player.CenterX() - Necro_Bolt.X()) + ToRad((Necromancer.Variable(Slot2) - ((Necromancer.Variable(FanCountP1) + (Necromancer.Variable(Phase) - 1) * (Necromancer.Variable(FanCountP2) - Necromancer.Variable(FanCountP1))) - 1) / 2) * Necromancer.Variable(FanSpread))

events.comment: Rain (Cast): when the staff flares (frame 9, index 8) a row of RainCountP1 (phase 2: RainCountP2) sigils glows on the ground around the player, RainSpacing apart. Each drops a bolt from the sky after RainDelay seconds, the middle ones first (RainGap between rings). Rain comes from above, so any deflect stops it (Directional 0).

Eruption (Cast): when the staff flares a sigil opens under the player; phase 2 adds two more, EruptGap to each side, a beat later. After EruptDelay a pillar of soul fire bursts out of each (see Sigils). The pillar is a heavy attack: deflecting it adds posture, like a melee hit.

Nova (Cast): his answer to being crowded. He glows red while the staff goes up (see the tint), then on frame 9 a ring of force bursts out NovaRange-wide around his feet. It is a heavy melee attack: deflect it facing him for 1.5x posture, or get out of range.
Blink, step 0: he fades out over BlinkTime seconds (he cannot be hit while blinking).
Gone: reappear on the far side from the player.
Blink, step 1: fade back in, then answer straight away with a bolt.

Skull swarm (Summon, phase 2): on frame 12 SkullCount skulls burst from his hand and hang in the air above him; then, SkullGap seconds apart, each dives at where the player is. They come from above, so any deflect stops them, and a deflected skull flies back at him like a bolt.
Flying: move by Vx, Vy (px per second).
Skulls waiting above him: glide to their spot, then each dives at the player in turn (0.7 s, then SkullGap apart).

A flying bolt with HasHit set either hit the player or was deflected (Combat_Shared set HasHit both times). A deflect leaves the player in IsDeflecting; a hit always ends it. Deflected: turn it back at him, brighter and faster.
It hit the player: burst and go.
Turned back: fly home.
A turned-back bolt reaches him: BoltPosture posture and BoltReturnDamage damage, unless he cannot be hit (blinking, the Rekindle, the intro): then it just bursts.
Off the screen, or into the floor: burst (on the floor) and go.

events.name: Necromancer: sigils, pillars, attack boxes and effects

events.comment: Sigils count up to their Delay, glowing faster near the end, then fire once: a bolt falling from the sky (rain) or a soul pillar with its attack box (erupt).
Attack boxes last Life seconds.
Effects go when their animation ends.
His tint, last word each frame: white; dimmed while stunned; pulsing red while the nova charges; a red flash after a hit.
Spell effects take the phase colour: sickly green in phase 1, blood red from the Rekindle on (BgMix). The arena script below does the same for the graveyard.

inlineCode: // Phase colours. BgMix on the Necromancer goes 0 -> 1 during the Rekindle; everything here follows it.
//   Arena pieces (the Grave_* backdrop) are multiplied by ARENA_P1 -> ARENA_P2, the fireflies and his outline
//   by FX_P1 -> FX_P2, and the spell effects (sigils, pillars, the nova) by FX_P1 -> FX_P2 too.
const lerp = (a, b) => a.map((v, i) => Math.round(v + (b[i] - v) * mix));
const arena = str(lerp(ARENA_P1, ARENA_P2)), fx = lerp(FX_P1, FX_P2), fxs = str(fx);
// The backdrop only needs it when the mix changes.
if (flies) for (const f of flies) f.s.tint = (fx[0] << 16) | (fx[1] << 8) | fx[2];
// New effects appear all the time, so they are tinted every frame.
for (const name of ["Necro_Sigil", "Necro_Pillar", "Necro_Nova"]) for (const o of runtimeScene.getObjects(name)) o.setColor(fxs);
